visual_logic: This standalone asset card introduces the Acrocanthosaurus for the gameplay pairing. It maps the same relatable, kid-friendly 'baby-tooth' gapped structure onto a brand new species profile, showcasing the sharp, curved, and flattened 'Grand Blade' tooth morphology while maintaining friendly, wide-open eyes.
prompt: A centered close-up headshot of a friendly Acrocanthosaurus, rendered in a high-fidelity 3D animated feature film style with soft, stylized, and slightly rounded edges. The character profile clearly features a prominent, low muscular ridge running down the top of its head and neck. The large, expressive brown eyes are wide open with a warm, cheerful, and completely non-threatening gaze directed at the viewer. Its mouth is wide open in a happy smile, presenting an endearing front-row gapped pattern where two upper front teeth are completely missing. Crucially, all visible teeth feature the specialized 'Grand Blade' morphology: they are cleanly white, sharp, distinctly knife-like, and laterally compressed (flattened from side-to-side) with subtle serrations, completely replacing the thick, round teeth of other predators. The skin has a beautiful, organic pebbled texture. Set against a bright, sunlit prehistoric landscape with clear blue sky. 1:1 square composition with crisp midday shadows and bright highlights.
